name: ChatDouble
description: A private AI chatbot platform where users can upload real chat history and recreate bots that mimic their friends' personalities. Built using Streamlit + FAISS + Mistral via Ollama.

paragraphs: ChatDouble lets you upload a WhatsApp or Instagram chat export, builds an AI "digital double" that texts like the person in it, and lets you chat with that double in a platform-faithful WhatsApp/Instagram-style UI. Usage is metered by a pay-as-you-go credit system.
